_bob.role: docs/GENERATION.md, the texture family: a reference photo to a seamless set
_bob.purpose: A reference photo to a seamless set: img2img at BOB_DENOISE with the reference's palette locked by IPAdapter, so the result is that surface rather than the checkpoint's idea of the words.
_bob.derived_from: tex_tileable.json (tex_tileable), with the empty latent replaced by an encoded reference and an IPAdapter pair added
deviations_from_source: EmptyLatentImage replaced by ImageScale(BOB_SIZE) -> VAEEncode, so the sampler starts from the reference rather than from noise. BOB_SIZE therefore binds to the resize, not to a latent.

The reference is encoded through the CIRCULAR VAE, not the stock one: a zero-padded encode writes the reference's own edge discontinuity into the starting latent, which is the seam tex_tileable exists to avoid.
IPAdapterModelLoader + CLIPVisionLoader + IPAdapterAdvanced patch the tiled model, so the palette survives a denoise high enough to remove the photo's lighting.
The KSampler carries BOB_DENOISE as a FIELD, not as a node of its own: see denoise_is_a_field below.
_bob.denoise_is_a_field: The plan's templated-title list names BOB_DENOISE alongside BOB_SEED as if they were separate nodes. They cannot be: templating binds a node by its single _meta.title, and seed and denoise are two widgets on ONE KSampler. Bob binds {'BOB_SEED': {'seed': s, 'denoise': d}} instead. docs/GENERATION.md says so.
_bob.notes: BOB_IMAGE's value is a filename in the server's input folder, uploaded by core.comfy.upload_image just before the queue, so it is declared a runtime input and preflight does not check the placeholder against the LoadImage enum. Denoise 0.65 is the default: low enough that the reference's structure survives, high enough that its baked lighting does not.

inputs.text: shadow, cast shadow, vignette, lighting gradient, specular highlight, glare, blur, depth of field, perspective, horizon, sky, plant closeup, object, text, watermark, signature, border, frame, seam
